May 26 Journal of Assembly 1 
 
Daily sitting 41 Tuesday, May 26, 2026 
1 o’clock p.m. 
Prayers. 
 
Hon. Mr. Herron offered condolences to the family of the late 
Robert K. Irving, Co-CEO of J.D. Irving, Limited. Mr. Weir joined 
in this regard. 
 
The following Bills were introduced and read a first time: 
 
By Hon. Mr. Legacy, 
Bill 46, Energy Sector Consumer Advocate Act. 
Bill 47, An Act Respecting the Energy Sector Consumer Advocate. 
Bill 48, Loan Act 2026. 
 
Mr. M. LeBlanc gave notice that on Wedn esday, May 27, 2026, 
Bills 46, 47 and 48 would be called for second reading. 
 
Mr. M. LeBlanc, Government House Leader, announced that it 
was the intention of government that Bill s 40, 41, 42, 43, 44 and 
45 be called for second reading. 
 
Debate resumed on the adjourned debate on the amendment to the 
motion that Bill 40, An Act Respecting Health Quality and Patient 
Safety, be now read a second time, moved by Mr. Oliver , seconded 
by Ms. M. Johnson, on May 15, 2026. 
 
And after some time, Mr. Arseneault, the Deputy Speaker, took the 
chair as Acting Speaker. 
 
Mr. M. LeBlanc rose on a point of order and submitted that 
Ms. Conroy was reading from an electronic device  during her 
speech. Mr. Deputy Speaker ruled the point well taken. 
 
And after some time, Madam Speaker resumed the chair. 
 
And the debate being ended, and the question being put on the 
amendment, it was resolved in the negative  on the following 
recorded division: 
 
YEAS - 13 
 
Mr. Savoie Ms. M. Wilson Mr. Cullins 
Ms. Scott-Wallace Mr. Weir Ms. Bockus 
Mr. Austin Ms. Conroy Mr. Lee 
Mr. Monahan Mr. Oliver  
Mr. Ames Mr. Russell

Hon. Mr. D’Amours Hon. Mr. Kennedy Mr. Robichaud 
Hon. Mr. McKee Ms. Wilcott Ms. Mitton 
Hon. Mr. C. Chiasson Mr. Mallet  
 
And the question being put that Bill 40 be now read a second time, 
it was resolved in the affirmative. 
 
Accordingly, Bill 40, An Act Respecting Health Quality and Patient 
Safety, was read a second time and ordered referred to the Standing 
Committee on Economic Policy, as designated by the Government 
House Leader. 
 
The Order being read for second reading of Bill 41, An Act to Amend 
the Local Governance Act, a debate arose thereon. 
 
And after some time, M adam Speaker interrupted proceedings and 
announced that the hour of daily adjournment had arrived. 
 
And then, 6 p.m., the House adjourned. 
 
The following document, having been deposited with the Clerk of 
the House, was deemed laid upon the table of the House pursuant 
to Standing Rule 39: 
 
Response to Petition 16 May 20, 2026
